header.tagline: Build circuits. See the electricity flow!

toolbar.parallelHint: Select a component to create parallel branches.

info.switchOn: Switch is ON — Click to Open
info.switchOff: Switch is OFF — Click to Close

circuit.generatorOffDetail: Move the voltage slider to power the circuit.
circuit.shortCircuitDetail: The circuit has zero resistance — infinite current would flow. An amperemeter is likely connected in parallel with a component. Amperemeters must always be in series.
circuit.openCircuitDetail: No current flows. Check that all switches are closed and there is a complete path from the generator.
circuit.voltmeterInSeriesDetail: A voltmeter has very high resistance — placing it in series blocks all current. Voltmeters must be connected in PARALLEL, across the component you want to measure.
circuit.ammeterInParallelDetail: An amperemeter has near-zero resistance — placing it in parallel creates a short circuit. Amperemeters must always be in SERIES.
circuit.wireInfoExplain: In a real circuit, wires have resistance that depends on material, length, and diameter. Longer or thinner wires have higher resistance — reducing the voltage available to the components.

freeMode.clickToPlace: Click on the canvas to place
freeMode.clickTerminal: Click a terminal dot to connect
freeMode.noGenerator: No generator found — add a voltage source to the circuit.
freeMode.openCircuit: The circuit is open — no complete path for current to flow.
freeMode.tooComplex: This circuit is too complex for automatic analysis. Try simplifying your connections.
